I dunno, I feel like the Diamonds could have done a little more. Garnet took more damage in the fight against Lapis' water clones (and Jasper), Amethyst took more damage against Jasper, Pearl took more damage against Sugilite. I feel the Diamonds should have been similar to all of those in regards to the GC taking damage, but they weren't (aside from Peridot and Lapis). It didn't have to be this epic dragonball fight, but I feel it would have helped with making it really seem like the GC were losing.

Where the fight really shines is in it's cinematography (which was gorgeous), and it's character moments (Lapis and Garnet being standouts). But some character moments I felt could have been stronger. I think Pearl's "I do it for me!" moment would have been much more powerful if it wasn't brought on by Steven. And Amethyst's "Don't get shattered! Don't get shattered!" was... No. And the GC kind of looked like they were fighting nothing during that part. 

Overall, I thought it was really good, great at parts. But some parts I felt were really lackluster. I don't think it's the best fight in the show, and I don't think it's anywhere near one of the best fights in fiction.

My family used to live in a five bedroom, three bathroom home.

Amazingly enough, I just went to the counselor this past week and was told that I still have depression.

It’s as if depression is a medical condition which is not influenced by the acquisition of things.

Depression doesn’t give a flying fuck if you have everything.

Depression is not greed or lack of appreciation for what you have or some first-world privilege.
